title: SuperPipeline card.ready
description: A card became ready to be claimed on a board opted into scheduling: it reached a stage an agent may claim from in a claimable state, or was resumed or returned there. A placement service reacts to it at once instead of waiting for its sweep; it is a hint, and the board read stays the truth. Sent only by a board with a placement window (charter: SuperDispatch owns the scheduler). Mirrors SuperPipeline's CardReadyBody (apps/api/src/board/placement-window.ts). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Never null: the event is routed by its board.

stageKey.description: The stage the card is ready at.

readyAt.description: When the card became ready: where its placement window starts.

placementWindowUntil.description: Until when the board holds the card back from pull so it can be placed. Absent when the board has no window. A hold made inside the window is claimable by its agent at once.
